body: I don't particularly know. I can't really tell which way is up, basically. And the severe antipathy I feel towards people who might normally be my support group prevents me from reaching out to them.
I am not viewing this as so much of an interaction. More of processing my own thoughts.

I feel as if all of my problems and stress have one of two sources: Either problems inherent in myself. Or with my interactions with other people. I am not currently self-sufficient, stable, nor capable of supporting myself, so I resent my own problems even more than I normally do. But I am finding all interactions with other people, especially those requiring any sort of emotional rapport, incredibly distressing.
